app.name: Little Alchemy 2
app.long_description:
Start with water, fire, earth and air. Point with the Wii Remote, drag one element onto another and see what you create. All 720 elements and recipes of Little Alchemy 2 to discover.
A: drag (double-press A to copy) B: remove the element under the pointer -: clear the table 1: hint 2: hide finished elements +: menu (music and sound on/off, reset) HOME: exit Also plays with the Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube controller, Wii U GamePad, Wii U Pro Controller, DualShock 3, USB mouse and USB keyboard.
With the audio pack in the audio folder it plays Little Alchemy 2's music and sound effects.
Progress and settings are saved to the SD card.
